locations.note: B.J. spends fourteen years in a psychiatric asylum in Poland and later hides at Anya's grandparents' farm; neither is given a town.
A checkpoint in Stettin, today's Szczecin, on the way to Berlin.
Eisenwald Prison and the Kreisau Circle's hideout in the capital of the victorious Reich.
The London Nautica research tower holds the Da'at Yichud files B.J. needs.
Camp Belica, an invented forced-labour camp in northern Croatia.
The Gibraltar Bridge spans the strait to Africa in the game's 1960; B.J. climbs it to reach the Nazi lunar programme.

routes.name: B.J.'s campaign
routes.note: After fourteen years in a Polish asylum, B.J. fights through the Stettin checkpoint to Berlin, London, Camp Belica in Croatia and the Gibraltar Bridge.
